title: From ‘Royal Wedding’ Mugs to ‘Paper Rings,’ Taylor & Travis Wedding Merch Has Already Hit the Internet
summary: These are all unofficial items of course, but well, they're actually romantic.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

It’s official: Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce are now husband and wife.

The duo tied the knot Saturday (June 3) at Madison Square Garden in New York City, in a star-studded ceremony that was officiated by Adam Sandler . The guest list, meantime, reportedly included Selena Gomez, Ed Sheeran, Sabrina Carpenter, the HAIM sisters and Kelce’s Kansas City Chiefs teammates. And yes, the bride wore white, in a custom wedding dress by Jonathan Anderson for Christian Dior Haute Couture .

As details slowly trickle out about the ceremony — with photos no doubt soon to follow — savvy Swifties have already taken to the internet to create their own wedding merch and wedding gifts inspired by pop culture’s reigning royal couple. These are all unofficial items of course, but well, they’re actually romantic , and make great wedding gifts for Taylor Swift fans, or fun collectibles for pop culture fans, whether you’re single, taken or just down bad .

Here’s a look at the best Taylor Swift and Travis Kelce wedding-inspired merch to pick up online now.

Taylor and Travis Royal Wedding Memorabilia Mug

$25

Buy Now AT ETSY

“Tayvis” hiring police escorts and taking over an entire city block for their wedding had many comparing their big day to the royal wedding, and I guess if you’re a fan of the couple — or of pop culture in general — this really is like our royal wedding of 2026.

Commemorate the occasion with this fan-made ceramic mug, which features an image of the couple designed like a royal crest, along with a mirrorball crown above them. More easter eggs: there’s a wolf and arrowhead representing the Kansas City Chiefs’ mascot and stadium, respectively, along with a butterfly and unicorn symbol for Taylor (with a snake peeking out too cause IYKYK). As the Etsy seller explains, two blue quills at the bottom of the design are “symbolic of the love story they are writing.”

Taylor Swift-Inspired Bride T-Shirts

$13.45 $26.90 50% off

You can also pick up these T-shirts, inspired by lyrics from Swift’s hit songs, “Lover” and “Love Story.”

Choose from more than a dozen T-shirt colors and then choose the lyric you want printed on it. The 100% cotton T-shirts are available in sizes XS to 3XL.

"I'd Marry You With Paper Rings" Ring Dish

$13.35 $33.37 60% off

Inspired by lyrics from “Paper Rings,” a song off Swift’s 2019 album, Lover , this wedding gift idea gets you a heart-shaped ceramic dish for your rings, bracelets, keys and other small accessories. You can also choose to have the same quote printed on a classic round jewelry dish.

So It's Gonna Be Forever Greeting Card

$9.00

While our wedding invite to Swift and Kelce’s big day was (presumably) lost in the mail, we can pick up this Swift-inspired wedding card, which takes its design from the singer’s Billboard Hot 100 chart topper, “Blank Space.”

Also: totally joking about the wedding invite. We were obviously not on the list.

Taylor Swift-Inspired Champagne Glasses

$34.91

While we’re waiting to find out what song Taylor and Travis danced to for their first dance, or what was served at the reception, you can toast to the happy couple with these champagne glasses, which are etched with lyrics from Swift’s song, “Invisible String,” off her Grammy-winning 2020 album , Folklore .

This set gets you two champagne glasses made from real glass. The Etsy seller says the glasses are dishwasher-safe, and reviewers say the inscriptions do not fade even after multiple use.

My Sticker Dress-Up Swifties: The Wedding!

$8.07 $12.99 38% off

Buy Now On Amazon

The official wedding photos haven’t dropped yet (as of this writing), but illustrator Louise Anglicas has created this sticker book imagining what she thinks Swift and Kelce’s ceremony could look like.

There are 24 pages featuring various locations, backdrops and even mock wedding invitations, and you can create your own version of the festivities with the 500 reusable stickers that range from flowers to gowns. Included with the book is a silver-tone chain with a handcrafted red rhinestone heart charm at the end. The chain measures 18 inches in length while the heart comes with a lock and key clasp. 

Brain Games – The Wedding: Taylor & Travis

$5.97

Amazon also sells this trivia book inspired by Taylor and Travis’ wedding. Get 128 pages of quizzes, puzzles, word searches, brain teasers and more.

There are even sections about the couple’s famous celebrity friends (many of whom were at the wedding), Swift’s iconic Eras Tour , and even the couple’s pets.

Swiftie by Marriage Sweatshirt

$67.17

Buy Now AT REDBUBBLE

Of course, Kelce has long professed his love for his now-wife and for her music, but this sweatshirt makes it official. It’s a great gift idea for anyone who’s coming over to the Swift side after getting married too.

Redbubble has this design available on a T-shirt or printed on this cozy oversized sweatshirt, in ten different colors and sizes XS to 3XL.

Taylor & Travis Forever Ultimate Fan Edition Little Golden Book Biography

$9.07 $10.99 17% off

And if you really want to commemorate the Swift-Kelce nuptials, you can pick up this children’s book, which tells the story of how Taylor and Travis met and fell in love.

Part of the Little Golden Book Biography series, this 48-page picture book was just released in March and is currently 17% off on Amazon.
